title: Duplicate reserve event decrements stock twice
incident_report: When a reserve event is redelivered, inventory is decremented twice for the same transaction, causing stock to drop lower than it should.
symptoms: two reservations for one transaction and product
expected_root_cause: reserve is not idempotent; it does not detect an existing reservation for the transaction and product before decrementing again

mutations.replace: // idempotency removed: duplicate reserve events now decrement twice
